method: Purposive follow-up, all 40 retained 10-FPS frames per block rendered from original crops at 200px. Not full native-frame-rate review, prevalence estimates or input labels.

definitions.none_visible: No new player-attributable muzzle emission visible in retained frames; not proof that firing input was off.
definitions.visually_stable: Scenery appears stable in both axes, with continuing gameplay activity; not verified zero movement input.
definitions.quality_hold: Do not train on held source until neighboring interval audit and a new versioned eligibility manifest resolve it.
definitions.omitted_category: Not annotated, not an absence claim.

annotations.notes: Maze wall remains visible; wall translation and intermittent player bullet emission.
Sparse eight-frame review missed muzzle emission between sampled offsets. Dense review finds firing; do not count as a non-firing block.
No player emission in 40 retained frames; food and arena edge drift slightly. This is low motion, not a confirmed stationary action.
Green player does not visibly emit bullets; slight late aim turn while food translates. Red opponent bullets remain distinct.
Maze traversal with visible player emission and barrel turn; enemy drones do not disqualify player.
No cyan player emission in 40 frames. Red opponent fires. Maze walls and ordinary pentagon are visible.
No new player muzzle emission over 40 frames; a pre-existing projectile exits at the beginning. Food scrolls while multi-barrel orientation changes.
A green projectile emerges from the barrel early in the block between sparse offsets. Second missed firing example from the sparse sample.
No emission; almost empty crop gives no reliable scenery anchor. Small late barrel turn does not establish independent aiming while stationary.
Confirms ordinary and large pentagons in accepted training footage; multi-barrel player fires while turning.
Confirms ordinary blue pentagon in validation; player firing and food translation.
No player emission in 40 frames while maze walls translate; opponent red bullets remain visible.
Ordinary pentagon enters upper crop; dense muzzle frames resolve previously uncertain firing attribution as seen.
Player shoots along a long horizontal maze edge. Vertical relative position is stable; edge supplies no reliable horizontal-motion anchor. Not a verified fully stationary interval.
Large cyan bullet emerges in frames 1-2, between sparse offsets. Third missed firing example among ten prior not-seen blocks.
No player emission in all 40 frames while scrolling through maze and changing barrel orientation.
Red player emits bullets. Repeating grid appears stable but no unique two-dimensional scenery anchor; not a verified zero-input action.

Player rotates barrel through large angles while arena boundary, grid and another tank remain stable. Positive visual independent-aim example; keyboard/mouse inputs unknown. Damage flashing is visible.
Large red player emits no new projectile; other red player fires. Arena boundary stable horizontally, no strong vertical scenery anchor.

Full original context identifies level-37 Triple Shot ordinary shooter. Nearby triangular projectiles belong to other players. No new player muzzle emission visible; barrel rotates slightly but no fixed scenery anchor. Context image 003 inspected.
Two perpendicular arena boundaries and grid stay fixed. Small other-player projectiles cross later; no new large player muzzle emission visible. Stationary visual reference, controls unknown.

Initial motion then player, second player and in-flight projectile become static for most of block. Suspected source freeze, not stationary gameplay evidence. Hold this block and audit neighboring interval before any training.
Red player fires and turns, but team boundary translates clearly; automated low-flow candidate is a false stationary hit.
Accepted training source contains narrow maze corridors; player emits large cyan rounds and turns.
Accepted training source contains parallel maze walls, food and barrel turning without visible player emission.
Training maze walls with multi-barrel firing, turning and other players.
Validation contains ordinary and clearly large pentagons; red player emits and rotates.
Validation ordinary and large pentagons, continuous multi-barrel emission and turning.
Validation large pentagon visibly takes hits; multi-barrel firing and turning with food scrolling.
Validation maze with ordinary and large pentagons; player emits large round late in block.
Freeze-only rejection is not a truly frozen image: opponent enters/moves and player turns slightly while maze wall stays fixed. Candidate for full re-review, not automatic reinstatement.
Opponent projectile moves near end despite stationary player. Added Zzz text makes this unsuitable for automatic reinstatement; preserve rejection.
Maze walls translate gradually while no player emission is visible. Low mean-delta freeze criterion rejects low-motion footage; requires full re-review before reinstatement.

Red player rotates barrel while two perpendicular team-area boundaries remain fixed; no player emission. Freeze-only screening rejected visible aiming activity. Re-review full quality/class checks before reinstatement.

training_holds.scope: entire source until bounded interval audit resolves new suspected freeze at 70-74 seconds
training_holds.reason: Player, other player and in-flight projectile remain static after initial motion; previously quarantined 430-470 seconds does not cover this.
training_holds.resolution: Review original native-frame-rate footage around 70-74 seconds, extend bounds as needed, preserve existing exclusions, rebuild a versioned cohort and revalidate boundaries/hashes; do not mutate v5.
